rationale: The short thesis is fully intact: price remains well below falling session VWAP ($55.00) and the 9-EMA ($54.11), the push to new session lows printed the heaviest bar of the sequence (50.8K shares) while every bounce bar since is light volume (<3.4K), indicating continuation rather than absorption, and the risk-off tape (SPY -0.79%, VIXY +2.92%) is unchanged with no new headlines. The $53.05 retest target is only ~0.9% below and the original $54.68 stop still fits inside the $222.85 remaining loss budget, so there is no mechanical justification to exit; conversely, a flip long against a 6x-RVOL distribution day into the lows has no supporting evidence.
